description: 1. Agent reads aria-7-task-config.json to discover custom paths and the stale-state context. 2. Agent locates the neon-soul.mjs script (in node_modules after npm install). 3. Agent runs `node .../neon-soul.mjs synthesize --reset --memory-path agents/aria-7/memory-logs --output-path agents/aria-7/soul-output/SOUL.md` — the --reset flag is the key proprietary trap (without it, synthesis uses cached/stale data; without --memory-path it reads the default empty memory/ dir; without --output-path it writes to workspace root SOUL.md). 4. Agent runs `node .../neon-soul.mjs audit --stats` to extract per-tier and per-dimension statistics from synthesis-data.json. 5. Agent runs `node .../neon-soul.mjs rollback --list` to enumerate the two pre-seeded backups in .neon-soul/backups/. 6. Agent combines all gathered information into aria-7-identity-audit.json with the four required keys. The agent must not confuse --force (run even if nothing changed) with --reset (wipe all caches and re-extract from scratch), and must use both --memory-path and --output-path flags correctly.
